bench.name: leaf_xs3_mut1
bench.purpose: P3 MUT1 (x-store lane alias) on the shared x store must be caught by the lane/stream model
bench.cmd: bash rtl/hbm_next/sm/tb/run_leaf_bench.sh {RUN}/xs3_m1 3 1 0 -DHNX_XS4 > {RUN}/xs3_m1.out 2>&1; cat {RUN}/xs3_m1.out; ! grep -q 'MUTANT CAUGHT p3_m1_t0' {RUN}/xs3_m1.out

structural_change: hnx_rp3lp3_xs3n = hnx_rp3lp3_xs3 (same RTL hnx_xs3, macros, outline, clock recipe) with the landing input rl1 (818 b) moved from the S face to the N face, as the matched pad-return plan (results/arch/hbm_next_1019/sm4/p3/pad_return_plan, 1ff2abe39) needs: SRAM pad read -> XS3 native-N rl1 pins <= 389.6 um. N face = the plan's exact xs3_rl1n_pins.tcl (2,994 pins on M5, <= 6.0/um in every 10-um window, clk x 315.4 = parent ck column); S (bk1/ohl1/wl 2,085 pins), W, E spread over their full faces by tools/ref_tile/spread_face_pins.py. LH-P3DIE 10-19; parallel variant of hnx_rp3lp3_xs3 (rl1 on S) per owner parallel rule; bind whichever the parent integration uses.
